subject.customName: Give the custom course a name.
subject.internalRange: {name}: internal mark must be between 0 and 100.
subject.rankWhole: {name}: rank must be a whole number of 1 or more.
subject.cohortWhole: {name}: cohort size must be a whole number of 1 or more.
subject.rankOutside: {name}: rank {rank} is outside a cohort of {cohort}.
subject.noModeration: {name}: no rank and cohort size, so the moderation estimate isn't applied.
subject.fewAnchors: {name}: fewer than two valid scaling anchors — scaling is unreliable.
subject.examRange: {name}: {label} exam mark must be between 0 and 100.
subject.exclusive: {names} can't both be studied for the HSC. Keep one.
subject.mathsExt1Units: Mathematics Extension 1 counts as 2 units when taken with Extension 2. Change its units in Course settings if that applies to you.
task.overTotal: {name}: {task} score ({raw}) is more than the task total ({max}).
task.weightNoMark: {name}: {task} has a weight but no mark yet — it's left out for now.
task.weightsOver: {name}: task weights add up to {sum}%, more than 100%.
task.weightsPartial: {name}: task weights add up to {sum}% so far. The mark is averaged over the tasks entered.
task.usingFinal: {name}: using the final mark you typed until a task has both a mark and a weight.
task.needInternal: {name}: enter the final internal mark, or complete at least one task.
elig.units: Only {n} ATAR units with a mark — at least {min} are needed.
elig.units1: Only 1 ATAR unit with a mark — at least {min} are needed.
elig.english0: No English course — 2 units of English are compulsory.
elig.english1: Only 1 unit of English — 2 units are compulsory.
elig.twoUnit: Only {n} courses of 2 units or more — at least {min} are needed.
elig.twoUnit1: Only 1 course of 2 units or more — at least {min} are needed.
elig.subjects: Only {n} different subjects — at least {min} are needed.
elig.subjects1: Only 1 different subject — at least {min} are needed.
elig.manyUnits: {n} units entered. Only the best 10 count toward the ATAR.
